note: Time budgets per named machine (machines.json), read by tests through budget(key) from @aethervtt/shard-core/test-env (spec 0075). Milliseconds unless an entry says otherwise with `in` (frames, ratio). Kinds: target (what the product wants), unit (cost per `per`, times the test's count), rate (`per` a second, a floor), guard (a measured value; the limit is value × (1 + margin), and pnpm bench --ratchet proposes lowering it when a run beats it by more than twice its margin). Every entry has a note: a change to a number is a diff with a reason.

gpu:foliage.note: 0045: 2.2M grass blades in view within 60 m at 960×540, full density with no budget, GPU frame with the layer minus without (median): a regression guard, since in an app foliage adapts to its scatter-walk slice (FoliageBudget, 0075 part B). The laptop measured 18.49 ms in the first 0075 bench (2026-10-08), then 19.10, 19.67, 19.64, 19.77 and 20.37 ms in quiet reruns; part A, before foliage drew in a foliage/draw pass of its own, measured the same. Leads: compute each visible instance's transform once in the cull pass, and a simpler material for the farthest level. The desktop's 3 ms is 0045's number, not measured. scatter/src/bench.test.ts.

post-stack.what: the playground's #post courtyard with every post effect on, flown along postCamera
post-stack.note: Shares from three laptop benches of the scenario (2026-10-08, render/src/post-stack.test.ts), each slice the worst measured share rounded up, headroom the rest. GPU frame p95 7.27, 6.49 and 6.55 ms; GPU slices by ablation (the laptop's passTiming), less their noise: post 1.08, 1.30 and 1.30 ms, tonemap 0.23, 0.53 and 0, prepass 0.33, 0.27 and 0, ssao up to 0.57, shadows up to 0.20, atmosphere up to 0.33; forward-opaque measured 0-0.03, so 0.03 is proposed. Ablation here is noisy (tonemap's raw p95 read 0.97 ms in one run and 0 in the next). CPU frame p95 1.78-1.90 ms, render 97-98% of it: headless, the render systems are the frame. In Chrome on the laptop the same scene at 1920x1080 holds 120 Hz (gpu:frame p50 4.13 ms, no missed vsync over 600 frames; scripts/post-baseline.mjs); at the panel's native 3024x1964 it doesn't (gpu:frame p50 9.36 ms, frame interval p50 12.1 ms). The desktop is unmeasured. Keys cover the spans the path records, none twice: gpu:prepass, gpu:ssao (gtao and upsample), gpu:forward-opaque, gpu:shadows (cascade0-3), gpu:atmosphere (sky-view, aerial, sky), gpu:post (atmosphere, fog, taa, motion-blur, dof*, bloom*, exposure), gpu:tonemap; instance-cull and light-clusters fall in headroom. CPU: render (render systems and node encodes).

scatter-walk.what: star-explorer's planet, walking through forest with grass
scatter-walk.note: Shares from the laptop's first 0075 bench (2026-10-08), each the measured share of the frame rounded up, headroom the rest. GPU slices by ablation (the laptop's passTiming): gpu:foliage 0.13-0.61 ms, gpu:tonemap 0.07-0.18 ms over four runs (floors of 1 and 0.25 ms: a sub-millisecond pass found by ablation, the difference of frames that vary by 10-20 ms, is mostly noise); CPU p95 render 5.62, scatter 0.37, terrain/select 0.34, terrain/planets 0.031 ms of a 7.08 ms frame. Known miss on the laptop: gpu:forward-opaque (10.81, 29.38 and 23.12 ms over three runs; ablating it is noisy on the M4) and gpu:shadows (12.81 and 12.24 ms) don't fit a 16.6 ms frame together, so the laptop overrides them absolutely at the measured value plus about 10%; their shares, and the desktop's whole split, are proposals, unmeasured. Lead: shadows, 4 cascades over the forest's trees and props. Keys cover the spans the walk records (scatter/src/scenario.test.ts), none twice: gpu:forward-opaque (terrain, rocks, bushes, trees), gpu:foliage (foliage/place, /cull, /draw; FoliageBudget's default target), gpu:shadows (cascade0-3), gpu:tonemap; terrain/generate, instance-cull and light-clusters fall in headroom. CPU: render (render systems and node encodes, terrain/encode included), scatter (scatter/props), terrain/select, terrain/planets. The laptop's CPU frame measured 7.08 and 8.19 ms p95 in two quiet runs against the 8 ms target, terrain/select 0.34 and 0.52 ms: near their limits, to settle with more quiet runs.

planet-descent.note: Shares from the laptop's first 0075 bench (2026-10-08), each the measured share of the frame rounded up, headroom the rest: GPU p95 gpu:forward-opaque 3.26 ms and gpu:tonemap 0.25 ms of an 8.06 ms frame (gpu:terrain measured 0 at p95, generation being spiky: 0.05 is proposed); CPU render 2.86 ms, terrain/planets 0.046 ms. Known miss on the laptop: terrain/select at 5.6 ms in the descent against a 0.8 ms slice, which puts the CPU frame at 8.25 ms against 8. The laptop overrides it absolutely at 6.2 ms until selection is fixed; its 0.1 share is a proposal. Lead: terrain/select at 5.6 ms in the descent. The desktop is unmeasured. Keys cover the spans the descent records (terrain/src/scenario.test.ts), none twice: gpu:forward-opaque (the terrain draws), gpu:terrain (terrain/generate), gpu:tonemap; instance-cull and light-clusters fall in headroom. CPU: render (render systems and node encodes, terrain/encode included), terrain/select, terrain/planets.

crowd.note: Shares from the laptop's first 0075 bench (2026-10-08), each the measured share of the frame rounded up, headroom the rest: GPU by ablation gpu:forward-opaque 1.16 ms and gpu:shadows 1.61 ms of a 7.54 ms frame, gpu:instance-cull and gpu:tonemap 0 (under ablation's resolution: 0.02 and 0.01 are proposed); CPU render 2.94 ms of a 3.44 ms frame. The desktop is unmeasured. Keys cover the spans the turntable records (render/src/crowd.test.ts), none twice: gpu:forward-opaque, gpu:shadows (cascade0-3), gpu:instance-cull (0022's cull pass), gpu:tonemap; light-clusters falls in headroom. CPU: render (render systems and node encodes). Re-runs (2026-10-08, main and the post-stack branch alike) measured render 0.888 and 0.895 of the frame, so its share is 0.9; gpu:tonemap, 0 on one run and 0.39 ms by ablation on the next (sub-millisecond: noise), has a 0.5 ms floor on the laptop, as scatter-walk's small slices do.
